prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `pi update`, then `npm ci && npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test` on this branch. The tests load the Pi that `pi update` installed, and typecheck reads the new Pi types. The release notes above list new extension API features to adopt. If typecheck fails on TypeBox types, set the `typebox` devDependency to the version Pi's own package.json lists.

Before merging: run this extension in T3 {{{newVersion}}} and check the bridge it depends on, T3's MCP tools (`src/t3-mcp.ts`) and the prompt sections it trims (`src/bridge-trim.ts`). Then run `npm test`.

Before merging, sync `pstack/` to v{{{newVersion}}} on this branch. `pstack/` holds no Pi changes, so take the upstream text as it comes. Then run `npm test`. If an overlay patch in `overlay/overlay.json` no longer matches, update that patch to the new upstream wording and rerun `npm test`.

```sh
rm -rf /tmp/t3-pstack
git clone -q https://github.com/chhoumann/t3-pstack /tmp/t3-pstack
git -C /tmp/t3-pstack switch -q -c release v{{{newVersion}}}
FILTER_BRANCH_SQUELCH_WARNING=1 git -C /tmp/t3-pstack filter-branch \
  --prune-empty --subdirectory-filter plugins/pstack release
git fetch /tmp/t3-pstack +release:pstack-upstream
git merge -X subtree=pstack pstack-upstream
```

Merge this PR with a merge commit, never squash or rebase, so the next sync still finds its merge base.
